guardrails: Coaching pages must not claim to diagnose, treat or cure medical or mental-health conditions.
ADHD coaching is performance and systems coaching, not clinical diagnosis or treatment.
Nervous-system coaching must distinguish coaching practice from clinical care.
Burnout coaching must direct significant or worsening symptoms to an appropriate healthcare professional.
Do not invent qualifications, client outcomes, testimonials, scarcity or numerical claims.
